title: NIT Rourkela Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: National Institute of Technology Rourkela (NIT Rourkela) has officially released a notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow Posts. Candidates with B.E/ B.Tech or M.E/ M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering can grab this chance and apply for the NIT Rourkela Notification 2026 .
